english: I am waiting outside the hotel lobby, and the driver is standing near the parking entrance, but neither of us can see the other.
tanglish: Naan hotel lobby-ku veliya wait pannitu irukken, driver parking entrance pakkathula nikkiraanga, aana rendu perukkum oruthar oruthara paakka mudiyala.

english: Please tell the driver that I have reached the pickup point and that I am standing beside the security guard.
tanglish: Naan pickup point-ku vandhuten-nu driver-kitta sollunga, naan security guard pakkathula nikkiren.

english: The driver is only three minutes away, but there is a lot of traffic near the signal, so he may take a little longer to arrive.
tanglish: Driver innum moonu minutes distance-la dhaan irukkaaru, aana signal pakkathula romba traffic irukku, so avaru vara konjam late aagalam.

english: I have a blue suitcase and a black backpack with me, so the driver should be able to recognize me easily.
tanglish: En kitta oru blue suitcase-um black backpack-um irukku, so driver enna easy-ah identify panniduvaanga.

english: Please ask the driver to wait near the main gate because I need a few minutes to collect my luggage.
tanglish: En luggage eduthuttu vara enakku konjam time aagum, so driver-a main gate pakkathula wait panna sollunga.

english: I think the driver has taken the wrong road because the distance shown on the map is increasing instead of decreasing.
tanglish: Driver thappana road-la poittu irukkaaru-nu ninaikkiren, yenna map-la distance koraiyaama adhigama aagittu irukku.

english: My destination is Chennai Central, but the driver seems to be heading toward Egmore, so please confirm the destination with him.
tanglish: En destination Chennai Central, aana driver Egmore pakkam poittu irukkaaru pola irukku, so avar kitta destination-a confirm pannunga.

english: I received the OTP a few seconds ago, but I want to make sure that I am giving the latest code to the correct driver.
tanglish: Enakku sila seconds-ku munnadi OTP vandhuduchu, aana latest code-a correct driver-kitta dhaan share panren-nu confirm pannikanum.

english: Please tell the driver to slow down because I have not finished putting my luggage inside the vehicle.
tanglish: En luggage-a vehicle-kulla innum complete-ah veikkala, so driver-a konjam slow-ah drive panna sollunga.

english: I am currently standing on the opposite side of the road, and I will cross over as soon as the traffic becomes lighter.
tanglish: Naan ippo road-oda opposite side-la nikkiren, traffic konjam koranjadhum naan cross panni vandhuruven.

english: The driver said he would reach in ten minutes, but the application now shows an estimated arrival time of eighteen minutes.
tanglish: Driver ten minutes-la reach aagiduven-nu sonnaaru, aana ippo application-la eighteen minutes ETA kaamikudhu.

english: I need to reach the railway station before my train departs, so please avoid roads with heavy traffic if there is another route available.
tanglish: En train kelamburadhukku munnadi railway station-ku reach aaganum, so vera route irundha heavy traffic irukkura roads-a avoid pannunga.

english: The pickup location has changed because the original entrance is temporarily closed for construction.
tanglish: Construction work nala original entrance temporary-ah close pannitaanga, so pickup location change aagiduchu.

english: Please ask the driver whether he can wait for five minutes while I finish my meeting and come downstairs.
tanglish: Naan meeting-a mudichittu keezha vara five minutes aagum, adhukku varaikkum wait panna mudiyuma-nu driver kitta kelunga.

english: I cannot hear the driver clearly because there is too much background noise around me.
tanglish: Enna suthi romba background noise irukku, so driver enna clear-ah kekka mudiyala.

english: The driver is calling me, but I am currently unable to answer the phone because I am inside a meeting.
tanglish: Driver enakku call pannitu irukkaaru, aana naan ippo meeting-kulla irukken, so phone attend panna mudiyala.

english: Please tell the driver that I am standing next to the red signboard directly opposite the pharmacy.
tanglish: Pharmacy-ku exact opposite-la irukkura red signboard pakkathula naan nikkiren-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

english: I have already shared my live location, but the driver says that the map is showing a different entrance.
tanglish: Naan already live location share panniten, aana map-la vera entrance kaamikudhu-nu driver solraaru.

english: The vehicle number is TN 38 AB 7294, so please confirm that this is the correct vehicle before I get inside.
tanglish: Vehicle number TN 38 AB 7294, so naan vehicle-kulla yeruradhukku munnadi idhu correct vehicle dhaana-nu confirm pannunga.

english: If the driver reaches before me, please ask him to wait near the security cabin instead of leaving the pickup location.
tanglish: Driver enakku munnadi vandhuttaaru-na, pickup location-a vittu pogama security cabin pakkathula wait panna sollunga.

english: I have three bags with me, including one fragile suitcase, so please make sure there is enough space in the trunk.
tanglish: En kitta moonu bags irukku, adhula oru fragile suitcase-um irukku, so trunk-la pothumaana space irukka-nu check pannunga.

english: The road ahead is blocked because of an accident, so the driver may need to take a longer route to reach the destination.
tanglish: Accident nala munnadi road block aagirukku, so destination-ku reach aaga driver konjam long route edukkanum pola irukku.

english: I accidentally left my phone charger in the vehicle, so please contact the driver and ask whether he found it.
tanglish: Thappudhala en phone charger-a vehicle-kulla vittuten, so driver-a contact panni avarukku adhu kidaichudha-nu kelunga.

english: The driver dropped me at the wrong entrance, and I need directions to reach the actual destination from here.
tanglish: Driver enna wrong entrance-la drop pannitaanga, inga irundhu actual destination-ku eppadi poganum-nu directions venum.

english: I am not familiar with this area, so please explain to the driver exactly where I need to be picked up.
tanglish: Enakku indha area pathi familiar illa, so enna exact-ah enga pickup panna vendum-nu driver-kitta explain pannunga.

english: The map says that the destination is only two kilometers away, but the current traffic could make the journey take more than fifteen minutes.
tanglish: Map-la destination rendu kilometers dhaan distance-nu kaamikudhu, aana current traffic nala journey fifteen minutes-ku mela aagalam.

english: Please ask the driver to confirm the final fare before we start the trip because the amount shown on my application has changed.
tanglish: Trip start panradhukku munnadi final fare-a confirm panna driver-kitta sollunga, yenna application-la kaamikura amount change aagiduchu.

english: I can see the vehicle approaching from the left, but I am not sure whether it is the taxi assigned to my booking.
tanglish: Left side-la oru vehicle varradhu enakku theriyudhu, aana adhu en booking-ku assigned aana taxi dhaana-nu sure-ah theriyala.

english: The driver has arrived at the pickup point, but he is waiting on the other side of the building.
tanglish: Driver pickup point-ku vandhutaanga, aana building-oda opposite side-la wait pannitu irukkaaru.

english: Please tell the driver that I will be wearing a grey jacket and carrying a red suitcase.
tanglish: Naan grey jacket pottuttu red suitcase eduthuttu iruppen-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

english: Please tell the driver that I am waiting near the blue entrance.
tanglish: Naan blue entrance pakkathula wait pannitu irukken-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

english: The driver is waiting at the wrong gate, so please redirect him to the main entrance.
tanglish: Driver wrong gate-la wait pannitu irukkaaru, so avara main entrance-ku vara sollunga.

english: I am already inside the vehicle, and we are ready to start the trip.
tanglish: Naan already vehicle-kulla irukken, trip start panna ready-ah irukkom.

english: Please ask the driver to stop near the next signal.
tanglish: Adutha signal pakkathula vehicle-a stop panna driver-kitta sollunga.

english: The driver is moving in the opposite direction from my destination.
tanglish: Driver en destination-ku opposite direction-la poittu irukkaaru.

english: I think the map has not updated my new pickup location yet.
tanglish: En new pickup location-a map innum update pannala-nu ninaikkiren.

english: Please wait for me near the entrance while I finish my phone call.
tanglish: Naan phone call-a mudikkura varaikkum entrance pakkathula enakkaga wait pannunga.

english: The security guard is asking for the vehicle details before allowing the driver inside.
tanglish: Driver-a ulla viduradhukku munnadi security guard vehicle details kekkaraaru.

english: I have reached the location, but the driver has not arrived yet.
tanglish: Naan location-ku vandhuten, aana driver innum varala.

english: The driver said he is five minutes away, but the map shows ten minutes.
tanglish: Driver five minutes distance-la irukken-nu sonnaaru, aana map-la ten minutes kaamikudhu.

english: Please tell the driver that I am standing next to the ATM.
tanglish: Naan ATM pakkathula nikkiren-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

english: I cannot cross the road because there is too much traffic right now.
tanglish: Ippo romba traffic irukkuradhunaala ennaala road cross panna mudiyala.

english: Please ask the driver to wait until the traffic signal turns green.
tanglish: Traffic signal green aagura varaikkum wait panna driver-kitta sollunga.

english: The vehicle is parked behind the building near the loading area.
tanglish: Vehicle building-oda pinnadi loading area pakkathula park pannirukku.

english: I am carrying a large suitcase, so I need some help putting it in the trunk.
tanglish: En kitta periya suitcase irukku, so adha trunk-la vekka konjam help venum.

english: Please confirm whether the driver has the correct booking details.
tanglish: Driver kitta correct booking details irukka-nu confirm pannunga.

english: I received a notification saying that the ride has started, but I am still waiting outside.
tanglish: Ride start aagiduchu-nu notification vandhudhu, aana naan innum veliya wait pannitu irukken.

english: The driver accidentally cancelled the ride while I was getting into the vehicle.
tanglish: Naan vehicle-kulla yerumbodhu driver thappudhala ride cancel pannitaanga.

english: Please ask the driver if he can take the highway instead of the local road.
tanglish: Local road-ku badhila highway-la poga mudiyuma-nu driver-kitta kelunga.

english: I would prefer to take a slightly longer route if it has less traffic.
tanglish: Traffic kammiya irundha konjam long route-a irundhaalum parava illa, adha eduthukkalaam.

english: The driver is approaching the pickup point from the other side of the bridge.
tanglish: Driver bridge-oda opposite side-la irundhu pickup point-ku vandhuttu irukkaaru.

english: Please tell the driver not to park directly in front of the entrance.
tanglish: Entrance-ku direct-ah munnadi park panna vendam-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

english: I am standing near a large white signboard with the building name on it.
tanglish: Building name irukkura periya white signboard pakkathula naan nikkiren.

english: The driver cannot hear me because there is too much traffic noise.
tanglish: Romba traffic noise irukkuradhunaala driver ennaala pesuradha kekka mudiyala.

english: Please repeat the destination because I want to make sure it is correct.
tanglish: Destination-a marubadiyum sollunga, adhu correct dhaana-nu naan confirm pannanum.

english: I have changed my destination, so please update the new location before we leave.
tanglish: Naan destination change panniten, so naanga kelamburadhukku munnadi new location-a update pannunga.

english: The driver is asking me which entrance he should use.
tanglish: Endha entrance use pannanum-nu driver enna kekkaraaru.

english: Please tell him to enter through the gate next to the petrol station.
tanglish: Petrol station pakkathula irukkura gate vazhiya ulla vara sollunga.

english: I am waiting near the reception desk on the ground floor.
tanglish: Naan ground floor-la reception desk pakkathula wait pannitu irukken.

english: The driver has reached the destination, but I need help finding the correct building.
tanglish: Driver destination-ku vandhutaanga, aana correct building-a kandupidikka enakku help venum.

english: Please ask the driver to call me when he reaches the pickup location.
tanglish: Driver pickup location-ku vandhadhum enakku call panna sollunga.

english: I accidentally left my wallet in the back seat of the vehicle.
tanglish: Thappudhala en wallet-a vehicle-oda back seat-la vittuten.

english: Please contact the driver and ask him to check the back seat.
tanglish: Driver-a contact panni back seat-a check panna sollunga.

english: The vehicle is moving very slowly because the road is crowded.
tanglish: Road-la romba crowd irukkuradhunaala vehicle romba slow-ah poittu irukku.

english: I need to reach the airport as quickly as possible.
tanglish: Enakku mudinja alavukku seekiram airport-ku reach aaganum.

english: Please tell the driver that I have a flight in two hours.
tanglish: Innum rendu hours-la enakku flight irukku-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

english: There is a road closure ahead, so we need to take a different route.
tanglish: Munnadi road close pannirukkaanga, so naanga vera route-la poga vendiyadhu irukku.

english: I am not sure whether this is the correct vehicle, so please verify the vehicle number.
tanglish: Idhu correct vehicle dhaana-nu enakku sure-ah theriyala, so vehicle number-a verify pannunga.

english: Please tell the driver that I will meet him near the entrance in two minutes.
tanglish: Rendu minutes-la entrance pakkathula driver-a meet panren-nu sollunga.

english: If the driver cannot find me, please ask him to call me instead of cancelling the ride.
tanglish: Driver enna kandupidikka mudiyalena, ride cancel pannama enakku call panna sollunga.

english: Please tell the driver that I am waiting near the lift on the ground floor.
tanglish: Naan ground floor-la lift pakkathula wait pannitu irukken-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

english: The driver has reached the location, but he is standing near a different building.
tanglish: Driver location-ku vandhutaanga, aana vera building pakkathula nikkiraanga.

english: I am coming out of the building now, so please ask the driver to wait for a minute.
tanglish: Naan ippo building-la irundhu veliya varren, so driver-a oru minute wait panna sollunga.

english: Please tell the driver to stop near the yellow board on the left side.
tanglish: Left side-la irukkura yellow board pakkathula stop panna driver-kitta sollunga.

english: The driver is waiting near the wrong entrance, and I am walking toward him now.
tanglish: Driver wrong entrance pakkathula wait pannitu irukkaaru, naan ippo avara nokki nadandhu varen.

english: I can hear the driver, but I cannot see him because there are too many people around me.
tanglish: Driver pesuradhu kekkudhu, aana enna suthi romba per irukkuradhunaala avara paakka mudiyala.

english: Please ask the driver to stay where he is until I reach the vehicle.
tanglish: Naan vehicle-kitta varaikkum driver irukkura edathulaaye wait panna sollunga.

english: The map shows that the driver is nearby, but I cannot find the vehicle.
tanglish: Map-la driver pakkathula irukkaaru-nu kaamikudhu, aana vehicle-a kandupidikka mudiyala.

english: I think the driver has entered the wrong street.
tanglish: Driver thappana street-kulla poittaaru-nu ninaikkiren.

english: Please ask the driver to come back to the previous signal.
tanglish: Previous signal-kku thirumbi vara driver-kitta sollunga.

english: I am standing beside a red car near the main gate.
tanglish: Main gate pakkathula red car-oda pakkathula naan nikkiren.

english: Please tell the driver that I am wearing a black jacket and carrying a blue bag.
tanglish: Naan black jacket pottuttu blue bag eduthuttu irukken-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

english: The driver has called me twice, but I could not answer the phone.
tanglish: Driver rendu thadava enakku call pannaaru, aana ennaala phone attend panna mudiyala.

english: I will call the driver back once I finish speaking to the security guard.
tanglish: Security guard-kitta pesi mudichadhum driver-ku thirumbi call panren.

english: Please ask the driver whether he can wait for another ten minutes.
tanglish: Innum ten minutes wait panna mudiyuma-nu driver-kitta kelunga.

english: The driver says he has arrived, but I am still five minutes away.
tanglish: Driver vandhutaaraam, aana naan innum five minutes distance-la irukken.

english: I am almost at the pickup point, so please ask the driver not to leave.
tanglish: Naan pickup point-kku almost vandhuten, so driver-a poga vendam-nu sollunga.

english: The pickup location is crowded, so it may take me a few minutes to find the vehicle.
tanglish: Pickup location-la romba crowd irukku, so vehicle-a kandupidikka enakku konjam time aagalam.

english: Please tell the driver to wait beside the pharmacy instead of the supermarket.
tanglish: Supermarket pakkathula wait pannama pharmacy pakkathula wait panna driver-kitta sollunga.

english: I am standing exactly where the map shows the pickup location.
tanglish: Map-la pickup location kaamikura exact edathula dhaan naan nikkiren.

english: The driver is moving in the wrong direction again.
tanglish: Driver marubadiyum thappana direction-la poittu irukkaaru.

english: Please check the navigation and make sure we are going toward the correct destination.
tanglish: Navigation-a check panni naanga correct destination direction-la dhaan poromaa-nu confirm pannunga.

english: The road is completely blocked, so we will have to take a different route.
tanglish: Road full-ah block aagirukku, so naanga vera route-la dhaan poga vendiyadhu irukku.

english: Please ask the driver to avoid the road near the market because it is usually very crowded.
tanglish: Market pakkathula irukkura road-a avoid panna driver-kitta sollunga, anga usually romba crowd-ah irukkum.

english: I am in a hurry because I have an appointment in thirty minutes.
tanglish: Enakku thirty minutes-la appointment irukku, so naan konjam avasaram-ah irukken.

english: Please take the fastest route even if the distance is slightly longer.
tanglish: Distance konjam adhigama irundhaalum parava illa, fastest route-la ponga.

english: The estimated fare has increased since I started the ride.
tanglish: Ride start pannadhula irundhu estimated fare increase aagiduchu.

english: Please explain why the fare is different from the amount shown when I booked the ride.
tanglish: Naan ride book pannumbodhu kaamicha amount-um ippo irukkura fare-um yen different-ah irukku-nu explain pannunga.

english: I think I left my sunglasses somewhere inside the vehicle.
tanglish: En sunglasses-a vehicle-kulla engaavadhu vittuten-nu ninaikkiren.

english: Please ask the driver to check underneath the passenger seat.
tanglish: Passenger seat-keezha check panna driver-kitta sollunga.

english: I have already paid for the ride through the application.
tanglish: Naan already application moolama ride-ku payment panniten.

english: Please confirm whether the payment has been received successfully.
tanglish: Payment successful-ah receive aachaa-nu confirm pannunga.

english: The application is showing an error when I try to make the payment.
tanglish: Payment panna try pannumbodhu application-la error kaamikudhu.

english: Please wait while I try the payment again.
tanglish: Naan payment-a marubadiyum try panra varaikkum wait pannunga.

english: The driver has reached the destination, but I need help finding the exact entrance.
tanglish: Driver destination-ku vandhutaanga, aana exact entrance-a kandupidikka enakku help venum.

english: Please tell the driver that I need to get down near the main entrance.
tanglish: Enna main entrance pakkathula drop panna vendum-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

english: I have an elderly passenger with me, so please stop somewhere that is easy to access.
tanglish: En kooda oru elderly passenger irukkaaru, so easy-ah access panna mudiyura edathula stop pannunga.

english: Please drive carefully because the road is wet and slippery.
tanglish: Road wet-ahum slippery-ahum irukku, so careful-ah drive pannunga.

english: I am not comfortable taking this route because it is unfamiliar to me.
tanglish: Indha route enakku familiar illa, so indha vazhiya poga enakku comfortable-ah illa.

english: Please let me know when we are approximately five minutes away from the destination.
tanglish: Destination-ku approximately five minutes distance-la varumbodhu enakku sollunga.

english: I need to reach the airport before 7:30 PM.
tanglish: Enakku airport-ku 7:30 PM-ku munnadi reach aaganum.

english: The driver has arrived.
tanglish: Driver vandhutaanga.

english: The driver will arrive in five minutes.
tanglish: Driver five minutes-la vandhuruvaanga.

english: The driver is waiting near Guindy.
tanglish: Driver Guindy pakkathula wait pannitu irukkaaru.

english: Tell the driver I am at the main gate with two bags.
tanglish: Naan main gate-la rendu bags-oda irukken-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

english: The OTP is 4821.
I am waiting near the parking entrance.
tanglish: Naan parking entrance pakkathula wait pannitu irukken.

english: I need to reach the airport.
tanglish: Enakku airport-ku reach aaganum.

english: I am standing near the security gate with a red suitcase, aana the driver has stopped on the opposite side of the road, so please ask him to turn around and come to the main entrance.
tanglish: Naan security gate pakkathula red suitcase-oda nikkiren, aana driver road-oda opposite side-la stop pannitaanga, so avara thirumbi main entrance-ku vara sollunga.

english: I'm standing near the security gate with a red suitcase, but the driver has stopped on the opposite side of the road, so please ask him to turn around and come to the main entrance.
tanglish: Naan security gate pakkathula red suitcase-oda nikkiren, aana driver road-oda opposite side-la stop pannitaanga, so avara thirumbi main entrance-ku vara sollunga.

english: Please share the OTP 4821.
tanglish: OTP 4821 share pannunga.

english: I am standing near the security gate with a red suitcase.
tanglish: Naan security gate pakkathula red suitcase-oda nikkiren.

english: Please wait for five minutes.
tanglish: Innum five minutes wait pannunga.

english: I am waiting near the security gate.
tanglish: Naan security gate pakkathula wait pannitu irukken.

english: I am waiting outside the building near the security gate, so please ask the driver to come here.
tanglish: Naan security gate kitta building outside-la wait pannit iruken, driver-a inge vara sollung.

english: The app is stuck on the searching screen for the last five minutes and hasn't matched a driver yet.
tanglish: App kadaisi ainthu nimishama searching screen-la stuck aayirukku, innum driver-a match pannala.

english: My location on the app seems to be pinned to a completely different area than where I actually am.
tanglish: App-la enoda location naan actual-a irukura area vida completely vera area-la pin aayirukku.

english: The estimated arrival time keeps changing every few seconds, so I'm not sure how long I should actually wait.
tanglish: Estimated arrival time konja nimishathukku onnu maari maari irukku, so exact-a evlo neram wait pannanum nu theriyala.

english: I need to cancel this ride since my plans changed suddenly, I hope there's no cancellation charge this time.
tanglish: Enoda plans suddenly change aanadhunaala indha ride-a cancel pannanum, indha thadava cancellation charge illama irukum nu nenaikuren.

english: The driver isn't moving on the map at all, so I think I should cancel and book a new ride instead.
tanglish: Driver map-la ippadiye nikkuraru, so naan cancel pannitu vera oru ride book pannuradhu nallaadhu nu nenaikuren.

english: Could you please rebook the ride with a different driver, since this one seems to be stuck somewhere far away.
tanglish: Vera driver-a vachu ride-a rebook pannalama, indha driver romba dhooram edho stuck aayirukura maadhiri irukku.

english: I accidentally booked the wrong pickup location, so could you help me cancel this without any penalty?
tanglish: Naan thappa vera pickup location book pannitten, so idha penalty illama cancel panna help pannunga.

english: Since the estimated wait time keeps increasing, I think it's better to cancel and try booking again later.
tanglish: Estimated wait time continuous-a jaasthi aagirathunaala, cancel pannitu appuram vera try pannuradhu nallaadhu nu nenaikuren.

english: The driver called and asked me to cancel from my end because of some issue with his vehicle.
tanglish: Driver call pannitu, vandi-la edho issue irukku so enoda side-la irundhu cancel pannunga nu kettaru.

english: The driver took a much longer route than necessary, and I don't think that was intentional but I'd like it noted.
tanglish: Driver venumaana route vida romba nera route edutharu, adhu intentional-a nenaikkala aana idha note pannanum nu solren.

english: I felt the driver was on the phone for most of the ride, which made me a little uncomfortable given the traffic.
tanglish: Driver ride full time-la phone-la pesikitu irundhaaru maadhiri thonuchu, traffic-la irundhathunaala enakku konjam uncomfortable-a irundhuchu.

english: The car had a strong smell of cigarette smoke, so I'd like to request a cleaner vehicle for future rides.
tanglish: Vandi-la cigarette smoke smell romba strong-a irundhuchu, so future ride-ku clean-a irukura vandi venum nu request pannuren.

english: The driver refused to switch on the AC even though it was requested, and I'd like this to be looked into.
tanglish: Request pannirundhalum driver AC podama irunthaaru, so idha paathukanum nu solren.

english: I was charged for a cancellation even though I cancelled well within the free cancellation window shown in the app.
tanglish: App-la kaattura free cancellation window-kulla cancel pannirundhalum, enakku cancellation charge podirukanga.

english: The driver arrived nearly twenty minutes late without any prior notification, which caused me to miss my appointment.
tanglish: Driver munnadi edhuvum sollama almost irubathu nimisham late-a vandhaaru, adhunaala enoda appointment miss aayiduchu.

english: The vehicle that arrived didn't match the number plate shown in the app, so I was initially hesitant to board.
tanglish: Vandha vandi-oda number plate app-la kaattura number plate-oda match aagala, so mudhalla naan erika hesitate pannen.

english: I'd like to raise a concern about the driver's rash driving, especially near the school zone we passed earlier.
tanglish: Driver-oda rash driving-a pathi oru concern raise pannanum, especially naanga cross pannina school zone pakkathula.

english: Thank you so much for waiting patiently, I really appreciate you accommodating the delay on my end.
tanglish: Patience-a wait pannadhukku romba nandri, enoda delay-a accommodate pannadhukku really appreciate pannuren.

english: I hope the rest of your day goes smoothly, and thanks again for getting me here safely despite the traffic.
tanglish: Unga naeku baaki nalla poga vendum nu nenaikuren, traffic-la irundhalum enna safe-a kuttitu vandhadhukku romba nandri.

english: Please take the flyover this time instead of the service road, since the service road usually has more traffic.
tanglish: Indha thadava service road-a vidama flyover-a edunga, service road-la usually traffic jaasthi irukum.

english: After the second traffic signal, please take a right turn and continue until you see a big temple on the left.
tanglish: Rendaavadhu traffic signal-kku aprom, right turn edunga, left side-la periya kovil varaikkum po.

english: There's a one-way street coming up, so please take the previous left instead of going straight.
tanglish: Munnadi oru one-way street varum, so straight-a poganum nu illama adhukku munnadi left edunga.

english: Please don't follow the app's suggestion here, since that road is closed for repair work right now.
tanglish: Inga app sollara route-a follow pannadheenga, andha road ippo repair work-ku close pannirukanga.

english: Once you cross the railway bridge, take the second lane on the right, not the first one.
tanglish: Railway bridge cross pannadhukku aprom, right side rendaavadhu lane edunga, mudhal lane venaam.

english: This area has a lot of one-way roads, so it might be easier if I guide you turn by turn instead of using the map.
tanglish: Indha area-la neriya one-way roads irukku, so map use pannadha vida naan turn by turn guide pannuradhu easy-a irukum.

english: Please slow down near the school zone ahead, since children usually cross the road around this time.
tanglish: Munnadi irukura school zone pakkathula slow-a poonga, indha time-la usually kuzhandhaikal road cross pannuvanga.

english: The GPS is showing a shortcut through the narrow lane, but that road is too small for this car to pass.
tanglish: GPS chinna lane-la shortcut kaattutu irukku, aana andha road indha vandi pogura alavukku chinnadhu.

english: Please continue straight past the bus stop, and I'll tell you exactly where to turn once we get closer.
tanglish: Bus stop-a thaandi straight-a po, naanga pakkathula vandhadhum exact-a enga thirumbanum nu solren.

english: Instead of turning at the roundabout, please take the road just before it that leads directly to my street.
tanglish: Roundabout-la thirumbadha, adhukku munnadi irukura road-a edunga, adhu direct-a enoda street-ku poidum.

english: The driver is almost here.
tanglish: Driver vandhuta maadhiri irukkaru.

english: The driver is already here.
tanglish: Driver already vandhutaru.

english: The driver has arrived, please come outside.
tanglish: Driver vandhutaru, please veliya vaanga.

english: The driver is behind the building.
tanglish: Driver building pinnaadi irukkaru.

english: The driver is waiting beside the gate.
tanglish: Driver gate pakathule wait pannuraru.

english: The driver has arrived near the building.
tanglish: Driver building pakathule vandhutaru.

english: Please tell the driver to come to the main entrance.
tanglish: Driver-a main entrance-ku vara sollunga.

english: The driver is in front of the building.
tanglish: Driver building munnadi irukkaru.

english: The driver is coming.
tanglish: Driver vandhutu irukkaru.

english: The driver is waiting at the main entrance.
tanglish: Driver main entrance-le wait pannuraru.

english: The driver is near the bus stop.
tanglish: Driver bus stop pakathule irukkaru.

english: The driver is near the signal.
tanglish: Driver signal pakathule irukkaru.

english: The driver has not arrived yet.
tanglish: Driver innum varala.

english: The driver is on the way.
tanglish: Driver vandhutu irukkaru.

english: The driver is at the opposite entrance.
tanglish: Driver opposite entrance-le irukkaru.

english: The driver is waiting on the other side of the road.
tanglish: Driver road-oda opposite side-le wait pannuraru.

english: The driver is parked outside.
tanglish: Driver veliya park pannirukkaru.

english: The driver is waiting in the parking area.
tanglish: Driver parking area-le wait pannuraru.

english: The driver reached the location.
tanglish: Driver location-ku vandhutaru.

english: The driver reached the wrong location.
tanglish: Driver thappana location-ku vandhutaru.

english: The driver is waiting near the security gate.
tanglish: Driver security gate pakathule wait pannuraru.

english: The driver is next to the security office.
tanglish: Driver security office pakathule irukkaru.

english: The driver is standing near the gate.
tanglish: Driver gate pakathule ninnutu irukkaru.

english: Please tell the driver that I am coming.
tanglish: Naan vandhutu irukken-nu driver-kitta sollunga.

english: The driver will reach in ten minutes.
tanglish: Driver ten minutes-la vandhuruvaru.

english: Please ask the driver to wait for five minutes.
tanglish: Driver-a five minutes wait panna sollunga.

english: Please ask the driver to wait there.
tanglish: Driver-a anga wait panna sollunga.

english: The driver is waiting outside.
tanglish: Driver veliya wait pannuraru.

english: The driver is waiting near the wrong building.
tanglish: Driver thappana building pakathule wait pannuraru.

english: The driver has arrived, but he is waiting near the wrong entrance.
tanglish: Driver pakathule vandhutaru, aana thappana entrance-le wait pannuraru.

english: The driver went to the wrong entrance.
tanglish: Driver thappana entrance-ku poitaru.

english: The driver is waiting at the wrong gate.
tanglish: Driver thappana gate-le wait pannuraru.

english: The driver came to the wrong location.
tanglish: Driver thappana location-ku vandhutaru.

english: Please drop me right in front of the pharmacy, not near the bus stop, since I need to pick up a prescription.
tanglish: Bus stop pakkathula illama, pharmacy munnadi thaan drop pannunga, naan prescription vaanganum.

english: This is not the correct building, my apartment complex is the next one, about two hundred meters ahead.
tanglish: Idhu correct building illa, enoda apartment complex adutha onnu, rendu nooru meter mela irukku.

english: Please stop the car here itself, I can walk the rest of the way since the road ahead is very narrow.
tanglish: Inga thaan vandi-a nikathunga, munnadi road romba narrow-a irukurathunaala baaki naan nadanthu poiduven.

english: Could you drop me at the back entrance instead of the front, since the front gate is currently closed for renovation?
tanglish: Front-a vidama back entrance-la drop pannalama, front gate renovation-ku ippo close pannirukanga.

english: Please wait for just a moment after dropping me, in case I need to come back for something I forgot.
tanglish: Drop pannadhukku aprom konja neram wait pannunga, naan edho marandhadha thirumba vara vendi irundha.

english: This is my stop, but please pull over a little further since there's a car parked right in front of the gate.
tanglish: Idhu enoda stop, aana konjam mela po, gate munnadi oru vandi park pannirukku.

english: Please be careful while dropping me here since the road has a small pothole right next to the curb.
tanglish: Inga drop pannumbodhu konjam careful-a irukanga, curb pakkathula oru chinna pothole irukku.

english: I need to be dropped exactly at gate number three, since the other gates don't allow visitor entry after six.
tanglish: Naan exact-a gate number moonu-la drop aaganum, vera gate-la aaru mani-kku aprom visitor entry kidaiyathu.

english: This is somewhat urgent since I have a flight to catch in an hour, so please try to take the fastest route possible.
tanglish: Idhu konjam urgent, oru mani neram-la enakku flight irukku, so mudinjavarai fastest route-a edunga.

english: I have two large suitcases with me, so could you please check if there's enough space in the boot?
tanglish: En kitta rendu periya suitcase irukku, so boot-la pothuma space irukka nu check pannunga.

english: Please be careful while lifting the bag into the boot, since it has some fragile items packed inside.
tanglish: Bag-a boot-la vekkumbodhu careful-a irukanga, adhukulla konjam fragile items pack pannirukken.

english: Could you help me take the bags out once we reach, since I'll have my hands full with the other items?
tanglish: Naanga reach aanadhum bag-a edukka help pannunga, en kaila vera items irukum.

english: We need to make one quick stop at the pharmacy on the way, it shouldn't take more than five minutes.
tanglish: Vazhila oru pharmacy-la chinna stop pannanum, ainthu nimishathukku mela edukkathu.

english: My friend will also be joining midway, so please stop near the bus stand after the second signal.
tanglish: Enoda friend kooda naduvula erikuvaru, so rendaavadhu signal-kku aprom bus stand pakkathula nikkunga.

english: Since this is a shared ride, please confirm if the other passenger is being picked up before or after me.
tanglish: Idhu shared ride-nala, vera passenger-a enakku munnadiya illana pinnadiya pick pannuvanga nu confirm pannunga.

english: We have two drop points on this trip, so please drop me first since my location is closer.
tanglish: Indha trip-la rendu drop point irukku, enoda location pakkathula irukurathunaala enna mudhalla drop pannunga.

english: Could you wait for two minutes at the ATM, I just need to withdraw some cash before we continue.
tanglish: ATM-la rendu nimisham wait pannalama, naan konjam cash edukanum, appuram continue pannalam.

english: Could you please share the OTP with the driver so he can confirm and start the trip officially?
tanglish: Driver-kitta OTP sollunga, avaru confirm pannitu trip-a officially start pannuvaaru.

english: I haven't received the OTP yet, could you resend it or check if there's a network issue on my end?
tanglish: Enakku innum OTP varala, mela onnu anupunga illana enoda side-la network issue irukka nu check pannunga.

english: The OTP the driver entered doesn't match what's showing on my screen, so could we try generating a new one?
tanglish: Driver podra OTP enoda screen-la kaattura OTP-oda match aagala, so pudhusa oru OTP generate pannalama?

english: Please don't start the trip until I confirm the OTP, since I want to make sure this is the correct vehicle.
tanglish: Naan OTP confirm pannura varaikkum trip start pannadheenga, idhu correct vandi thaana nu naan sure pannikanum.

english: Since my phone signal is weak right now, it might take a minute for the OTP message to actually reach me.
tanglish: Ippo enoda phone signal weak-a irukurathunaala, OTP message vara oru nimisham aagalam.

english: The app is showing that my driver has already reached the pickup point, but I've been standing outside for the last ten minutes and I don't see any car nearby, so I think either the GPS is showing the wrong location or he's waiting at a completely different gate.
tanglish: App-la enoda driver already pickup point-ku vandhuduchu nu kaattuthu, aana naan kadaisi pathu nimisham-a veliye nikkuren, romba nerama pakkathula oru vandi kooda kaanom, so ippadi thonuthu, GPS thappu location kaattuthu illana avaru vera edho gate-la wait pannuraru nu.

english: The reason I'm cancelling this ride is not because of the driver, but because the app charged me twice for the same booking, and until that refund is processed, I don't feel comfortable booking another ride using the same payment method, so I'll wait until customer support responds to my complaint.
tanglish: Naan indha ride-a cancel pannuratha karanam driver-a pathi illa, app anda booking-kku rendu thadava charge pannitutu, andha refund process aagura varaikkum, naan andha payment method-a use pannitu vera ride book panna comfortable-a feel pannala, so customer support enoda complaint-ku reply pannura varaikkum naan wait pannuren.

english: I can't come near, you're stopped for a while, please call the driver and tell him.
tanglish: Naan kitta vara mudiyathu, neenga konja nerathula stop pannitu iruken, driver-a phone panni sollunga.

english: Please tell the driver that once he crosses the second signal, he should not take the flyover like the app is showing, because there's road construction going on up there, and instead he should continue straight on the service road until he sees a petrol bunk on the right, and take the small lane right after that.
tanglish: Driver-kitta sollunga, rendaavadhu signal cross pannadhukku aprom, app kaattura maadhiri flyover-a edukkakoodadhu nu, mela road construction nadakkuthu, adhukku badhila service road-la straight-a po sollunga, right side-la petrol bunk varaikkum po, adha kadanthadhukku aprom irukkura chinna lane-la thirumbunga.

english: Since it's raining heavily right now and the traffic near the flyover is completely blocked because of a diversion, I think it would be better if the driver takes the inner road route instead of the main road, even if it takes a few extra minutes, because at least we won't be stuck for an hour.
tanglish: Ippo romba mazhai peiyurathunaalum, flyover pakkathula diversion irukkurathunaalum traffic completely block aagi iruku, so driver main road-a vidama inner road route-la po nu naan nenaikkuren, konjam extra nimisham aanalum paravaila, ella onnu mani neram jam-la nikkama irukalam.

english: I'm still at the office, it'll take a bit of time, please tell the driver to wait.
tanglish: Naan innum office-la iruken, konja neram aagum, driver kitta wait pannunga sollunga.

english: I am still at the office, it will take a bit of time, please tell the driver to wait.
tanglish: Naan innum office-la iruken, konja neram aagum, driver kitta wait pannunga sollunga.

english: Even though the fare shown in the app before the ride started was around two hundred rupees, the driver is now saying that because of the surge pricing and the toll charges on this route, the final amount will be almost double, so I want to know if this is normal or if I should file a complaint with support.
tanglish: Ride start aagurathukku munnadi app-la fare rendu nooru rupaa maadhiri kaattinalum, ippo driver sollara, surge pricing um indha route-la toll charge um irukkurathunaala, final amount almost double aagum nu, so idhu normal-a illana support-kitta complaint pannanuma nu enakku theriyanum.

english: I'm currently standing near the security gate outside the apartment complex, but since there are two entrances on this road, please ask the driver to confirm which side he's coming from before he gets confused and goes to the wrong gate.
tanglish: Naan ipo apartment complex veliye security gate pakkathula nikkuren, aana indha road-la rendu entrance irukkurathunala, driver confuse aagi thappu gate-ku poaradhukku munnadi, avaru eppadi vara pora nu confirm pannunga.

english: Since there are two of us traveling together but only one pickup pin was shared, please make sure the driver waits at the main entrance instead of the side gate, because my friend is coming from the other building and it'll be easier for both of us to meet him at one common point rather than confusing him with two different locations.
tanglish: Naanga rendu per kooda poganum aana oru pickup pin thaan share pannirukom, so driver side gate-a vidama main entrance-la wait pannanum nu confirm pannunga, en friend vera building-la irundhu varaaru, so rendu per onnu spot-la avaru kooda meet pannuradhu easy-a irukum, rendu vera location kudutha avaru confuse aaguvaaru.

english: Before you drop me off, could you please wait for exactly two minutes near the gate because I need to run inside and grab a package that I forgot, and I promise it won't take any longer than that since the security guard already has it ready at the front desk.
tanglish: Neenga ennai drop pannadhukku munnadi, gate pakkathula rendu nimisham exact-a wait pannunga, naan ulle odi marandha package-a edukkanum, adhu adhukku mela time edukkadhu nu naan promise pannuren, security guard already front desk-la ready-a vachirukaru.

english: I understand that the driver might be new to this area, but this is the third time he's missed the turn even after I explained it clearly, so at this point I think it would be faster if I just share my live location on WhatsApp so he can follow it directly instead of relying on the app's navigation.
tanglish: Driver-kku indha area pudhusa irukkalam nu enakku puriyudhu, aana naan clear-a solli kooda idhu moonaavadhu thadava avaru turn miss pannirukaru, so ippo naan WhatsApp-la enoda live location share pannitten na avaru direct-a follow pannalam, app navigation-a nambaama.

english: The car has already arrived here, but the address you gave is wrong, please confirm a bit.
tanglish: Vandi already inga vandhuduchu, aana neenga sonna address thappa iruku, konjam confirm pannunga.

english: I know I gave you the wrong drop location earlier by mistake, and I'm really sorry for the confusion, but if it's possible, could you please ask the driver to take a U-turn at the next signal and come back to the correct building, which is actually just two minutes away from where we currently are?
tanglish: Naan mudhalla thappu drop location kudutten nu enakku theriyum, andha confusion-ku romba sorry, aana mudinjaa, adutha signal-la driver U-turn edukkanum nu sollunga, correct building-ku thirumba vaanga, adhu ippo naanga irukura idathula irundhu rendu nimisham dhooram thaan.

english: Could you confirm whether the fare shown in the app already includes the toll charges for this route?
tanglish: App-la kaattura fare-la indha route-oda toll charge already add pannirukanga nu confirm pannalama?

english: I'd prefer to pay by UPI instead of cash, so please make sure the driver has a scanner code ready.
tanglish: Naan cash-a vida UPI-la pay pannuradha prefer pannuren, so driver kitta scanner code ready-a vachirukanga.

english: The final fare seems higher than what was quoted at the start, so could you explain why the difference happened?
tanglish: Final fare start-la sonnadha vida jaasthi maadhiri irukku, so idhu yeppadi difference vandhuchu nu explain pannunga.

english: I don't have exact change right now, so is it possible to round off the fare to the nearest ten rupees?
tanglish: Ippodhaikku enakku exact change illa, so fare-a adutha pathu rupaa-ku round off pannalama?

english: Since the ride included a toll crossing, please add that amount separately instead of clubbing it with the base fare.
tanglish: Ride-la toll crossing irundhadhunaala, andha amount-a base fare kooda clubbing pannadha, separate-a add pannunga.

english: I noticed I was charged twice for the same trip, so could you please look into this and process a refund?
tanglish: Naan same trip-ku rendu thadava charge aana maadhiri paakuren, so idha paathu refund process pannunga.

english: Is there any additional charge for waiting time, or is that already included in the total fare shown?
tanglish: Wait time-ku edhavadhu extra charge irukka, illana adhu already total fare-la include aayirukka?

english: Could you send me the receipt over email as well, since I need it for reimbursement from my office?
tanglish: Receipt-a email-lakum anupungala, enakku office-la reimbursement-ku vendiyathu.

english: Please come to the main gate, not the side entrance, since the side gate is locked right now.
tanglish: Main gate-ku vaanga, side entrance-ku venaam, ippo side gate lock-a irukku.

english: I am standing right next to the security cabin, wearing a blue shirt, so it should be easy to spot me.
tanglish: Naan security cabin pakkathula nikkuren, blue shirt podutu irukken, so enna kandupudikardhu easy-a irukum.

english: The pin you have is slightly off, so please ask the driver to come a little further down the road.
tanglish: Neenga vachiruka pin konjam thappa irukku, so driver-a konjam mela road-la vaanga sollunga.

english: I'm on the first floor of the mall, so it'll take me two minutes to come down to the parking area.
tanglish: Naan mall first floor-la irukken, so parking area-ku varadhukku rendu nimisham aagum.

english: Please tell the driver that our building doesn't allow cars inside, so he should wait at the main road.
tanglish: Driver-kitta sollunga, enga building-ku ulla vandi anumadhikama, so main road-la wait pannunga sollunga.

english: There are two apartments with almost the same name here, so please double check the block number.
tanglish: Inga rendu apartment almost same name-la irukku, so block number-a double check pannunga.

english: I just came out of the metro station, so please tell the driver to wait near exit number two.
tanglish: Naan ippo thaan metro station-la irundhu veliye vandhen, so driver-kitta exit number rendu pakkathula wait pannunga nu sollunga.

english: The address I entered is my office, but I'm actually waiting near the coffee shop right across the street.
tanglish: Naan podra address enoda office thaan, aana naan actual-a andha road-oda opposite-la irukura coffee shop pakkathula wait pannuren.

english: My phone battery is very low, so if the driver can't reach me by call, please try messaging instead.
tanglish: Enoda phone battery romba kammi irukku, so driver call panni reach panna mudiyalana, message pannunga sollunga.

english: It's quite dark near my house, so please tell the driver to flash the headlights once he's close so I can spot the car.
tanglish: Enoda veedu pakkathula romba irutta irukku, so driver kitta pakkathula vandhathum headlight flash pannunga sollunga, naan vandi-a kandupudikaren.

english: Please make sure the child lock is on for the back seat since I have a toddler traveling with me.
tanglish: Back seat-la child lock on-a irukanum, enakooda oru chinna kuzhandhai varudhu.

english: Could you drive a little more carefully around the speed bumps, since I'm feeling a bit motion sick today.
tanglish: Speed bump pakkathula konjam careful-a drive pannunga, enakku indha naeku konjam motion sickness maadhiri irukku.

english: Please avoid using the phone while driving, it makes me a little nervous especially in this traffic.
tanglish: Drive pannumbodhu phone use pannadheenga, adhu enna konjam nervous-a pannuthu, especially indha traffic-la.

english: Since it's raining heavily, please keep the wipers on and drive a bit slower than usual.
tanglish: Romba mazhai peiyurathunaala, wiper on-a vachitu usual-a vida konjam slow-a drive pannunga.

english: I noticed the seatbelt in the back seat isn't working properly, could you please help me fix it?
tanglish: Back seat-la seatbelt properly work aagala, idha fix panna help pannunga.

english: Please roll up the windows a little since the dust from the construction site is coming inside the car.
tanglish: Construction site-la irundhu dust ulla varudhu, so window-a konjam mela pottukanga.

english: There's a huge traffic jam near the flyover because of an accident, so it might take an extra twenty minutes.
tanglish: Flyover pakkathula accident irundhadhunaala periya traffic jam irukku, so extra irubathu nimisham aagalam.

english: Since there's a VIP movement expected on the main road, it might be better to take the bypass route instead.
tanglish: Main road-la VIP movement irukum nu expect pannuvanga, so adhukku badhila bypass route edukurathu nallaadhu.

english: The signal near the junction has been down for a while, so traffic is being managed manually and moving slowly.
tanglish: Junction pakkathula signal konja neramaaga work aagala, so traffic manual-a manage panniyum slow-a poitu irukku.

english: Because of the ongoing metro construction work, this stretch of road has been reduced to a single lane.
tanglish: Metro construction work nadakkurathunaala, indha road stretch single lane-a reduce aayirukku.

english: There seems to be a protest happening near the college, so a few roads in that area are currently blocked.
tanglish: College pakkathula protest nadakkura maadhiri irukku, so andha area-la konjam roads block aayirukku.

english: Since it's peak office hour right now, please expect the ride to take almost double the usual time.
tanglish: Ippo peak office hour-nala, usual time-a vida almost double time aagum nu expect pannunga.

english: I still have about ten more minutes of my meeting left, so please ask the driver to wait a little longer.
tanglish: Enoda meeting innum pathu nimisham irukku, so driver konjam nera wait pannunga sollunga.

english: I know I'm taking longer than expected, so please let the driver know I'll add a little extra for the wait time.
tanglish: Naan expect pannadha vida nera edukkuren nu enakku theriyum, so wait time-ku konjam extra kudukuren nu driver-kitta sollunga.

english: The doctor hasn't called my number yet, so it might take another fifteen minutes before I come out.
tanglish: Doctor innum enoda number call pannala, so veliye varadhukku innum padhinaindhu nimisham aagalam.

english: Please don't cancel the ride yet, I'm just finishing up inside and I'll be out in five minutes.
tanglish: Ippodhaikku ride cancel pannadheenga, naan ulla vela mudichitu irukken, ainthu nimishathula veliye varen.

english: The driver has been waiting for a while now, so please hurry up and come down as soon as possible.
tanglish: Driver nallaave neram wait pannitu irukaru, so fast-a veliye vaanga mudinjavarai.

english: I got stuck in a long queue at billing, so it'll take a bit more time than I originally told you.
tanglish: Naan billing-la neriya queue-la sikkitten, so naan mudhalla sonna time vida konjam nera aagum.

english: Since the flight got delayed by an hour, please tell the driver he doesn't need to wait right now.
tanglish: Flight oru mani neram delay aagirathunaala, driver ippo wait pannanum nu venaam nu sollunga.

english: I'm sorry for the delay, my previous meeting overran and I couldn't step out any earlier than this.
tanglish: Delay-kku sorry, enoda mudhal meeting nera edithukiduchu, adhukku munnadi naan veliye varamudiyala.

english: Since the road is completely flooded near the underpass, could you take an alternate route to avoid it?
tanglish: Underpass pakkathula road completely flood aayirukurathunaala, adha avoid panna alternate route edunga.

english: I know this is a bit of a strange request, but could you please turn off the AC for a few minutes, since one of the passengers just got a bit too cold?
tanglish: Idhu konjam strange request nu enakku theriyum, aana konja neramaachum AC-a off pannunga, passenger onnu konjam over-a cold aayirukku.

english: Brother, I know the meter is showing a different amount, but the app already confirmed a fixed price for this trip, so please go by that instead.
tanglish: Anna, meter-la vera amount kaattuthu nu enakku theriyum, aana app already indha trip-ku fixed price confirm pannitrukku, so andha price-a follow pannunga.

english: Brother, before you start the meter, could you confirm once whether you're taking the flyover or the ground route, since the fare changes depending on that?
tanglish: Anna, meter start pannadhukku munnadi, flyover-a edukkardhu illa ground route-a edukkardhu nu oru thadava confirm pannunga, adha vachu fare change aagum.

english: Uncle, I can see three cars matching that description near the gate, so could you flash your indicator once so I know which one is yours?
tanglish: Uncle, gate pakkathula sonna description-ku match aagura moonu car-a naan paakuren, so unga vandi edhu nu theriyuradhukku oru thadava indicator flash pannunga.

english: Brother, please don't take the route the app is showing right now, since there's a religious procession blocking that entire street for the next hour.
tanglish: Anna, app sollara route-a follow pannadheenga, andha street-a procession-nala adutha oru mani neramukku block pannirukanga.

english: Brother, I noticed the fuel gauge is showing quite low, so if you need to stop at a petrol bunk on the way, please let me know in advance so I'm not surprised by the delay.
tanglish: Anna, fuel gauge romba kammi-a kaattura maadhiri paakuren, so vazhila petrol bunk-la nikkanum na, munnadiye sollunga, delay-a paathu naan surprise aagama irukalam.

english: Brother, since it's already quite late and the streets are mostly empty, would it be okay to skip the usual route and take the highway instead, just to save some time?
tanglish: Anna, already romba raathiri aayidichu, streets-um mostly empty-a irukku, so usual route-a skip pannitu highway-a edukalama, konjam time save aagum.

english: Brother, I understand the bridge road is faster, but my stomach isn't doing too well today, so please avoid the bumpy stretch even if it takes a couple of minutes longer.
tanglish: Anna, bridge road fast-a irukum nu enakku theriyum, aana enakku indha naeku vayitru romba correct-a illa, so rendu nimisham nera aanaalum andha bumpy stretch-a avoid pannunga.

english: Please wait near the main gate.
tanglish: Main gate pakkathula wait pannunga.

english: I received the OTP a few seconds ago, but I want to confirm the vehicle number before sharing it.
tanglish: Enakku sila seconds-ku munnadi OTP vandhuduchu, share pannuradhuku munnadi vehicle number correct vehicle dhaana-nu confirm pannikanum.

english: I left my phone charger in the back seat after completing the ride, so please contact the driver and ask him to check.
tanglish: Thappudhala en phone charger-a back seat-la vittuten, so driver-a contact panni adha check panna sollunga.

english: There is heavy traffic near the signal, and the map is showing that our arrival time has increased by fifteen minutes.
tanglish: Signal kitta romba traffic irukku, so map-la arrival time innum fifteen minutes-ku mela aagalam.
